payload.reason: The evidence provides statistical data indicating that the PAMPO model improves named entity recognition (NER) performance over existing extractors, with specific metrics showing increases in performance measures.

claims.text: PAMPO increases NER by at least 0.25 compared to other extractors.
PAMPO shows higher mean performance metrics than AlchemyAPI, Rembrandt, and Zemanta.
The second phase of PAMPO increases a performance measure from 0.72 to 0.87.
PAMPO extracted a total of 12120 named entities, indicating a significant improvement in entity extraction.
